verdicts.one_liner: Gun bruiser still fits the tempo economy; Abrams and Lash remain the ceiling.
verdicts.indirect: Vitality items untouched and the lane-wins economy suits his tanky M1; Graves's gun now pops his traps, and gap-closers Abrams (38%) and Lash still lock him out of range.
build_adjustments: Keep Battle Vest as the first buy.
Hold the ~40% grenade charge pivot for late anti-tank.

verdicts.one_liner: Neutral tempo carry; Steam Vents help slightly, but Venator is still the better slot.
verdicts.indirect: Steam-Vent invisibility marginally helps Smoke Bomb picks, but the faster-closing economy puts her weak T4 gun finish (Ricochet/Capacitor) further out of reach, and Paige/Victor still beat her.
build_adjustments: Skip the Ricochet/Tesla late pivot unless the game goes long.

verdicts.one_liner: Pure-gun rebuild isn't moved either way; Paige still walls her.
verdicts.indirect: Gun-carry archetype neutral and no core item moved, but she's a late scaler in an economy that ends faster, and rising Paige still beats her (57%).
build_adjustments: Stay on the pure-gun fire-rate core.

verdicts.one_liner: C-tier late scaler in an economy that closes before he finishes building.
verdicts.indirect: The crate/camp, no-comeback economy ends games before his spike and Shadow Weave gains little from the new district/Steam-Vent layout; no core item moved.

verdicts.one_liner: Rising anti-tank gets fed by the new tank wave, if his low snapshot WR turns.
verdicts.indirect: The rising tank front (Abrams, Mo & Krill, Billy) is free food for current-HP Serrated Knives, and harder Haunt camps reward his regen stack; Yamato/Bebop burst still kills him early.
build_adjustments: Keep the regen core; knives gain value as frontlines rise.

verdicts.one_liner: Fastest Haunt clear plus new Flying Strike objective paths, top of A.
verdicts.indirect: Punch AoE is the patch's best clear of grouped, chasing Haunts, and Flying Strike now creates paths to the Shrines/objectives the new layout separates; Buff Container Ability Range adds value.
build_adjustments: Stay on the on-hit spirit proc backbone.
Use Flying Strike paths to reach separated Shrines and objectives.

verdicts.one_liner: Camps and districts suit her, but she still can't kill a tank.
verdicts.indirect: Grouped-Haunt AoE clear and new-district mobility suit her, but nothing fixes her real problem: single-target burst that can't kill the rising tank front (Billy, Mo & Krill, Victor).
build_adjustments: Farm camps with district mobility between dives.

verdicts.one_liner: Steam Vents and new districts sharpen her picks; divers still punish her.
verdicts.indirect: New districts, hiding spots and Steam-Vent invisibility upgrade her roamer setups and put her ahead of Bebop in the pick slot; mobile divers Yamato/Lash/Holliday still dive a stationary sniper.
build_adjustments: Use Steam-Vent invisibility for new pick angles.

verdicts.one_liner: Split-push scaler the contested economy buries; kit fine, meta hostile.
verdicts.indirect: Contested Soul Bags and the faster-closing tempo economy punish split-push scaling, and rising Mo & Krill silence and Lash dive beat him; his 46% WR confirms it.
build_adjustments: No build fix, the problem is the map economy, not his items.

verdicts.one_liner: Burn AoE farms the new Haunt camps, but the map still ends before his spike.
verdicts.indirect: Grouped, chasing Haunt camps reward his burn AoE, and Buff Containers now rolling Ability Range/Move Speed help the spirit line; the faster economy still ends before his late spike.
build_adjustments: Stay on Dashfernus; the farm tailwind favors spirit, not burn gun.

verdicts.one_liner: More districts and Steam Vents give the best pick assassin more lassos.
verdicts.indirect: New districts, hiding spots and Steam-Vent invisibility expand her roam, and Bell Tower hub fights reward Spirit Lasso picks; point-blank lockdown (Drifter, Bebop, M&K/Lash ults) still ends her.
build_adjustments: Keep Extra Charge/Rapid Recharge to double-dip bounce-pad and lasso casts.

verdicts.one_liner: Melee bruiser the new Steam Vents and Tough-Crate routes were built for.
verdicts.indirect: New districts, Steam Vents and heavy-melee Tough-Crate routes fit his stealth-reveal roam, and the rising tank/frontline archetype suits him; Dynamo/M&K/Apollo lane pressure still caps him.
build_adjustments: Take heavy-melee Tough Crate routes as a farm angle on your roam.

verdicts.one_liner: Lane-bully frontliner losing his slot to Mo & Krill in a sustain-and-farm economy.
verdicts.indirect: The crate/camp-uptime economy wants sustained presence, not his all-in, and his front-line slot has moved to rising Mo & Krill; anti-tank Shiv (his worst lane, 43%) is climbing.
build_adjustments: No item change; draft around Shiv rather than into it.
